lines.text: That's a big gun you've got. But it's not enough to hurt me.
You kids today think you're so hot? Well,
there's still some fight left in this old man. I'll-
My back... Ow ow ow ow ow!
I thought I was supposed to be your partner, not your nursemaid.
We're willing to call it a draw if you want, boy. Come on, Klaymoor. Let's go.
Oh, if it weren't for my back, I'd have wiped up the floor with them, I tell ya.
Yeah, yeah, yeah. Whatever you say.
